.qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r1/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (Known false positives: 'One criterion covering a whole flow ... Independence means no two criteria grade the same observable or demand incompatible products')
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping; A negative needs a successful control; dead feature must not earn credit)
handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md (lesson 16: row 28 double penalty; grade relative to a baseline or say 'scored elsewhere')
evidence:
Overall the task is carefully de-duplicated: many rows carry explicit ownership carve-outs, e.g. hro_job_open ('Whether the places limit and the manager's rights work is graded only in hro_interview_full and the manager rows', functional/judge.toml:31), hro_arrive_bottom ('Arrival of several cards together belongs to hro_bulk_move', :67), hro_interview_full ('Overfill by a multi-card move belongs to hro_bulk_places and by undo to hro_undo_full', :112), hro_undo_restores ('The A2 undo in B(12) is graded only in hro_undo_conflict', :247), hro_refusal_status ('a replay that was accepted is deducted only in its own row', :202), hro_drafts ('Clearing the box after sending is graded in hro_msg_compose', :382), hro_candidate_no_staff ('whether their conversations work is graded in hro_candidate_view', :184), hro_candidate_view/hro_candidate_private split (:391/:400), hro_candidate_linked ('This row alone owns that link', :409), hro_activity vs hro_activity_refusals (:274/:283, prompt.md:27), and polish hro_pol_live_thread/hro_pol_failed_send ownership lines (polish/judge.toml:34, :47). hro_restart (:418) follows lesson 16 correctly: it compares against a before-restart baseline ('unchanged') instead of re-grading order/undo/unread logic. No pair demands incompatible products: msg_compose (empty box after send/reload) vs drafts/session_resume (unsent reply persists) are compatible with rules 6 'Sending clears the draft'; refused_put_back focus vs pol_live_board focus are compatible; anonymous 401 vs refusal_status 403/404/409 cover disjoint replays; candidate_private's lenient board/Activity answer is compatible with no_staff. The four 'independent context reads the same order' legs (arrive_bottom, reorder, bulk_move, undo_restores) each grade a different operation's resulting order, which is acceptable per-operation outcome grading. 

Remaining defect (lesson 16 pattern, avoidable double penalty): candidate message sending is graded in hro_msg_exchange ('Tomas's reply appears on Rafael's open conversation', functional/judge.toml:310), but it is also a hard trigger for rows whose own promise does not depend on the sender being a candidate: hro_unread_counts ('after Tomas's two messages Rafael's count ... rises by exactly two'; 'Tomas's next message does not raise his count', :346), hro_unread_scrolled_up ('Noor's new message does not move his place ... told there is one new message', :355), and polish hro_pol_live_thread ('In an independent context Noor sends a message ... If Noor's message does not appear within 15 seconds ... this row is 0', polish/judge.toml:34). The timed-observation protocol makes a failed trigger void and, after three voids, 'the observation fails' (functional/prompt.md:21, polish/prompt.md:18). The public rule for unread counts is 'sent by anyone else' and for scrolled-up arrival/draft preservation is any arriving message (hireops_rules.md:156-165, :125-127), so a staff sender (e.g., Mei Lin, a recruiter who writes in every conversation) would observe the same promises without depending on candidate write access. This also conflicts with the prompts' own 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' (functional/prompt.md:31; polish/prompt.md:24), leaving the judge two contradictory instructions. hro_seen's candidate-sent legs (:364) are intrinsic (candidate-message seen is its own promise) and are not counted here.

Reviewed and accepted as necessary positive controls rather than double grading (REVIEW_POLICY 'A negative needs a successful control ... A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing'): hro_pol_live_board's 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds ... this row is 0' (polish/judge.toml:25) depends on the hro_live_board observable but preservation-under-update cannot be observed without an update; hro_refused_put_back (:139) presupposes the full-Interview refusal owned by hro_interview_full; hro_refusal_status 'If none of these replays was refused, this row is 0' (:202); hro_candidate_private's own-conversation control (:400) supports its not-found leg; hro_interview_reorder_free/hro_mgr_late_stages depend on a re-order control existing. These are P3 cascade notes only. Outside this row (for rows 6/27): hro_refusal_status accepts 403 'or 404 when the request names an application that is not theirs', while rules 1 make both 403 (role) and 404 (not theirs) applicable to a candidate replaying a move on another card; not an inter-criterion contradiction. No runtime was needed or used for this static row; no configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope says full configured grading is absent), so the cascade's real judge behaviour is NOT EXERCISED.
counterexample: A model app whose message-send route authorises only staff participants (candidate POST to their own conversation returns 403; candidate can still sign in, read applications and read conversations) but whose unread counting, scrolled-up notice and draft/focus preservation are fully correct for any arriving message. Tomas and Noor cannot send, so every timed trigger in hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up and hro_pol_live_thread is void three times and those rows score 0, on top of hro_msg_exchange (which correctly owns the defect). One defect costs 1.5+2+2 = 5.5 functional weight plus 2 polish weight, although a recruiter-sent message (Mei Lin) would show all three promises working.
suggested_fix: In hro_unread_counts, hro_unread_scrolled_up and hro_pol_live_thread (and the U/T protocol text), let the arriving message come from any other participant who can write there (e.g., Mei Lin in an independent context) or state that if the candidate's send is refused the judge uses Mei Lin's send instead, and add 'candidate sending is graded only in hro_msg_exchange'.
